name: PATTTTERNS
summary: Gallery of 400+ real UI and UX design patterns from live products, browsable by flow and component category.
description: A manually curated collection of real design patterns pulled from live products, each shown with the product it comes from (Slack, Google, Apple, Notion, Mercado Libre and more). Patterns split into UX flows (onboarding, call to action, search & navigation, success pages, terms, mail & newsletters) and UI components (modals, navbars, footers, form fields, dropdown menus, side sheets, carousels, tabs & pagination). Made for product makers studying how other products solved a screen.
contains: 400+ real design patterns from live products
261 examples mapped with UI element tags
sections: UX flows and UI components
UX flows: onboarding, call to action, search & navigation, success page, mail & newsletters
UI components: modals, navbars, footers, form fields, dropdown menus, side sheets, tabs, carousels
each pattern names its source product
